children: Venezuela's interim President Delcy Rodriguez has authorized Starlink, the satellite internet service operated by Elon Musk's SpaceX
, to operate in the Latin American country.
The authorization is part of an agreement with the US firm, the Venezuelan government said in a statement on Friday.

The company's satellite-internet unit has continued to expand its global subscriber base, aided by launches of additional satellites and a growing range of consumer, enterprise, aviation, maritime and government services.
